Break the chains of the past, and seize the promise of tomorrow—for those who have no future, for those who safeguard these shores, and... for yourself. |requirement = |startLocation = |prev = [[Legacy of the Lasting Night]] |next = [[Beyond the Shore's End]] |rewards = }} {{Intro/Quest|Advance toward the Future from Today}} == Summary == You have fallen into the tangled data web of the [[Tethys System]]. To deter you from rescuing [[The Shorekeeper|the Shorekeeper]], who is on the verge of becoming its core, the Tethys System reveals three potential futures in its absence: and ice age, a cataclysmic disaster, and the total reconstruction of civilization. Once a tool for observing civilizations, this cold and calculation system now stands in open rebellion against you. The final showdown is at hand—who will prevail, you or Tethys?
The Shorekeeper and you return to reality, landing on the very beach where you first arrived in the [[Black Shores]]. She explains her deception regarding the [[Stellar Matrix]] and expresses her gratitude. ==Steps== #Venture deeper into the Tethys System and find the Shorekeeper #Escape the frozen world #Escape the shattered world #Escape the Tethys System #Arrive at the Data Torrent #Neutralize the Tethys System #Defeat Fallacy of No Return: Tethys System ==Gameplay Notes== *Completing the quest awards the player ''[[Rover's Journey]]'' [[trophy]] ''[[One Last Ocean]]''. ==Dialogue== {{Quest Description|The past is not without meaning—it shapes our hopes for the future. While the past cannot be altered, it forms the foundation for pavind a new path ahead. Break the chains of the past, and seize the promise of tomorrow—for those who have no future, for those who safeguard these shores, and... for yourself.}} {{Dialogue Start}} ;(Optional - Talk to Morisha and [[Schubert]]) :'''Schubert:''' A navigator talked about this before. :'''Schubert:''' Tethys is extremely dependent on its core processor, which means... :'''Morisha:''' Do you mean Tethys is using the Shorekeeper as its core processor? :'''Schubert:''' It's possible. :'''Morisha:''' But that's so inhumane! She's a person too... :'''Schubert:''' Sigh... :
;(Optional - Talk to KU-Kelar) :'''KU-Kelar:''' Memory scan reveals the presence of a secondary instance... :{{DIcon}} Hmm? :'''KU-Kelar:''' Processing data... processing data... processing data... :'''KU-Kelar:''' Emotions are not variables. They are factors... :'''KU-Kelar:''' Please verify the input for potential errors... :'''KU-Kelar:''' Remember... tool... she... tool... :'''KU-Kelar:''' Never... assign... to... humans. :You can't understand what the little robot says... :
;(Optional - Talk to KU-Beck) :'''KU-Beck:''' Hmm... I can't really say. :'''KU-Beck:''' The Tethys System is a closed system. It keeps its core logic hidden. :'''KU-Beck:''' Can we really find the Shorekeeper in its data banks... :{{DIcon}} I can do it. :'''KU-Beck:''' Hmm! Uh... alright... :
;(Optional - Talk to KU-Wig) :'''KU-Wig:''' Want to try? If my hypothesis turns out to be correct... :{{DIcon}} What? :'''KU-Wig:''' Picture a drop of ink falling into the ocean. Eventually, it will come back together into its original form. :'''KU-Wig:''' Now, imagine that drop of ink is the Shorekeeper. :'''KU-Wig:''' We need to apply some external force to speed up this process. We're not just locating the Shorekeeper, we're reconstructing her. :'''KU-Wig:''' After being absorbed by Tethys, her frequency was fragmented and dispersed throughout it. :'''KU-Wig:''' It's time to test my theory... :
;(Optional - Talk to [[Kepler]]) :'''Kelper:''' Enzo, my old friend... :'''Kelper:''' If you're shining somewhere in this starry sky, please watch over us. :'''Kelper:''' Watch over the Black Shores, watch over the Shorekeeper... :'''Kelper:''' Let your starlight keep lighting our way forward. :'''Kelper:''' We will keep fighting for you... :
;(Optional - Talk to [[Constantine]] and [[Jiuri]]) :'''Constantine:''' If we keep scanning Tethys' memory, we can pinpoint the Shorekeeper's exact location. :'''Constantine:''' We won't... ever give up on anyone. :'''Jiuri:''' Her physical form may be lost in the Matrix, but she is still in there. :'''Jiuri:''' Because her entire frequency spectrum is still somewhere in Tethys. :{{DIcon}} The law of conversation? :'''Constantine:''' Yes! Hmm... so you're familiar with this concept, it's quite significant. :'''Constantine:''' If we can recover her frequencies, we can use Tethys to bring her back. :'''Jiuri:''' It'll be like finding a needle in a haystack... :'''Constantine:''' She believed in {{Rover}}. So, please trust us as well! :
;(Optional - Talk to [[Huanliu]]) :'''Huanliu:''' Can we... really do this? :{{DIcon}} You don't think it's possible? :'''Huanliu:''' Nobody in the Black Shores has ever gone against the Tethys System's directives, with the insurmountable task of tracking its codes. :'''Huanliu:''' It may as well be a code written by the gods... :{{DIcon}} Going against the god does sound thrilling. :'''Huanliu:''' Only you would say something like that. :'''Huanliu:''' But since we've decided to go through with this, I'll follow through. :'''Huanliu:''' No matter what, we have to say the Shorekeeper. :
;(Optional - Talk to [[Panoram]]) :'''Panoram''': Are we really challenging Tethys when it's locked down? :'''Panoram''': It'll be a miracle if we can even pull it off, but... :'''Panoram''': With the Shorekeeper helping us within Tethys and our comrades fighting bravely on the frontlines... :'''Panoram''': It's a gamble, but losing isn't an option. ---- ;(Enter the Tethys System) :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_61_1.ogg}} '''Stellar Matrix Navigator:''' What we're doing now is essentially breaking into the Tethys System. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_61_2.ogg}} '''Stellar Matrix Navigator:''' Plus, the transmission coordinates aren't certain. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_61_3.ogg}} '''Stellar Matrix Navigator:''' If you're ready, we can start the transmission now. :{{DIcon}} I'm ready. ::{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_61_6.ogg}} '''Stellar Matrix Navigator:''' Please get back to us safely! :{{DIcon}} I'm not ready yet. ::{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_61_7.ogg}} '''Stellar Matrix Navigator:''' Of course. Just come find me when you're ready. ---- :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_1.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Welcome, Chief Steward {{Rover}}. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_2.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' This is the Tethys System's data cache, used only for temporary storage. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_3.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Access here should be restricted. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_7.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' This system deduces that the Shorekeeper assigned admin access to you. :{{DIcon}} I'm here to get her and the others back. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_36.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Admin access nullified. Request denied. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_9.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' The Shorekeeper is now the core computational unit. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_10.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Forceful discharge of the core unit will result in system crash. :{{DIcon}} This can be prevented. They shouldn't be sacrificed in vain. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_12.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Objection. All sacrifices are necessary. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_13.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' The purpose of human civilization is to survive. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_14.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Over the past 10,000 years, a total of five global occurrences and over 300,000 regional occurrences of the Lament have been observed. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_15.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Thanks to this system's calculations and the Sentinels' data, we have averted all potential threats to human civilization on Solaris. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_16.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Individual sacrifices are inconsequential in the broader context of the common good. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_19.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Additionally, the Shorekeeper is composed of the Sonoro and is not human. :{{DIcon}} But she has feelings. :{{DIcon}} You are just a cold machine. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_22.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Emotions are unnecessary for survival. :{{DIcon}} But they spark civilizations. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_24.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Error: Unable to process... :{{DIcon}} I'll bring them back no matter what. :{{DIcon}} I won't leave anyone behind. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_27.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Repeat. Forceful discharge of the core unit will result in system crash. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_28.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' A world without this system is doomed to perish in the Lament. :{{DIcon}} I'll fix your error. :{{DIcon}} I've already found the solution. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_38.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Correction. This system is designed to preserve human civilization. Every command is infallible. :{{DIcon}} We save the world by holding onto our humanity. :{{DIcon}} An apathetic supercomputer can't be our savior. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_24.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Error: Unable to process... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_62_33.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Last warning. Forceful discharge of the core unit will activate the defense program. Consequences will be severe. :{{DIcon}} Bring it on! ---- ;(Cutscene plays) ;(Cutscene ends) ---- :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6203_1.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' The future ahead is frozen in cold silence... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6204_1.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Be careful... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6201_2.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Please... leave here... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6202_1.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Use the Grapple... to leave... ---- :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6205_1.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' The earth rent asunder, the world reduced to ashes... :{{A|vo bsmq 1_3_5618_3.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Target confirmed: Chief Steward. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6206_2.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Please go... Don't look back... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6207_2.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Must... protect you... ---- :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6206_1.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' My story ends here, but you must keep going. :{{A|vo bsmq 1_3_66_2.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' This System must continue to function... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_6207_1.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Calling... my last Sonoro... ---- ;(Cutscene plays) :{{A|vo bsmq 1_3_5618_3.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Target confirmed: Chief Steward. ;(Cutscene ends) ---- ;(Head to the designated location) :{{A|vo bsmq 1_3_5618_6.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' Initiating master command. ---- ;(Fallacy of No Return at 75% HP) :{{A|vo bsmq 1_3_66_2.ogg}} '''Tethys System:''' This system must continue to function... ---- ;(Defeated Fallacy of No Return) ;(Cutscene plays) :'''Tethys System:''' Defense verification unsuccessful... :'''Tethys System:''' This system must continue to function... :'''Tethys System:''' Re-initiating command. Implementing Third Contingency Protocol. :'''Tethys System:''' Execute formatting. Target: Shorekeeper. :'''Tethys System:''' Formatting: 37%... :'''Tethys System:''' Formatting: 62%... :'''Tethys System:''' Formatting: 85%... :'''Tethys System:''' Formatted. The Shorekeeper will be the new computational unit. :'''Tethys System:''' Only this ensures system continuity. :'''Tethys System:''' It is the only way to defeat the Lament. :'''Rover:''' You'd better... :'''Rover:''' Let her go! :'''Rover:''' I will not leave anyone behind! ---- :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_661_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_661_F.ogg}} :'''Rover:''' See? Just let it flow out of you, like this. :'''Rover:''' You can do it too. :'''Rover:''' Come, give it a try. :'''The Shorekeeper:''' No, you shouldn't be here... :'''The Shorekeeper:''' If you get integrated into Tethys, you won't be yourself anymore... :'''Rover:''' That won't be a problem. :'''Rover:''' Tethys and the Black Shores will find another way. :'''Rover:''' Someone kept this from me, didn't they? :'''Rover:''' That sounds familiar. I feel like I heard it before. :'''The Shorekeeper:''' A long time ago, you taught me how to play it. :'''Rover:''' I see. But I... I have no memory of it. :'''The Shorekeeper:''' I'll teach you... :'''The Shorekeeper:''' Just like you did for me before. ;(Cutscene ends) ---- :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_1.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' From the distant past to the far future, everything begins and ends here. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_2.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' When you established the Black Shores to unite Solaris, the Tethys System already existed. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_3.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Later, you discovered it relied on emotions from the Lament to fuel its calculations. Without them, it cannot function. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_4.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Using the Lament against itself is like walking on a Möbius loop with no end in sight. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_5.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' We have tried for millenia to break this cycle without success. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_6.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' And then... you left the Black Shores to look for other solutions. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_7.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' But deep down, you already knew the best solution. It was one you couldn't accept. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_8.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' That solution is me—the tool always meant to become Tethys' core. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_9.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' If I don't do this, you, as the Modulator of this system, will be chosen as the core. I must fulfill my duty to protect you. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_10.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' But... I want to be by your side, to see the skies you've seen, to tread the paths you've walked. I want to understand... what happiness really means. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_11.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' When I first discovered these emotions, I didn't know what to do... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_12.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' So I lied to you, thinking it was the best choice for both of us... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_13.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' I... I'm sorry... :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_14.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Sorry for putting you in harm's way... :{{DIcon}} "Salvation is about building a world where people no longer need to be saved." :{{DIcon}} This is why we return to this shore. :{{DIcon}} No one should be treated as a mere tool. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_22.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' I... :{{DIcon}} We're back at the Black Shores now, back to our home. :{{DIcon}} Welcome home, my Shorekeeper. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_25.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Yes. :{{A|Vo bsmq 1_3_68_26.ogg}} '''The Shorekeeper:''' Thank you. My... star. {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Advance toward the Future from Today |zhs = 便能在如今走向未来 |zht = 便能在如今走向未來 |ja = 輝かしい未来へと繋がる |ko = 오늘은 미래로 나아갈 수 있다 |fr = Construire l'avenir dès aujourd'hui |de = Vom Heute aus in die Zukunft voranschreiten |es = Avanzar hacia el futuro desde hoy |th = ก้าวไปข้างหน้าสู่อนาคตจากวันนี้ |pt = Rumo ao Futuro, a partir de Hoje }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.3}} ==Navigation== {{Quest Navbox|Main Quests}}
